info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Card Terminal Operation Status-spec
info.description: The Card Terminal Operation Status API allows consumers to retrieve the operational status of card terminals across various banking channels. This endpoint provides critical insights into the performance and availability of card terminals, enabling businesses to quickly identify any issues or outages. Typical consumers include bank operations teams and system administrators who need to monitor terminal functionality for better customer service. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their transaction processing reliability and improve overall user experience.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of a card terminal operation.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of a card terminal operation associated with a specific channel. Use this operation to check if the operation is in progress, completed, or if there were any issues during processing.

requestBody.description: Request to retrieve the status of a specific card terminal operation within a given channel. The payload should conform to the expected schema for accurate processing.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the current status is returned.

ListCardTerminalOperationStatusRequest.description: Represents the status of card terminal operations in the context of a specific channel.

ListCardTerminalOperationStatusResponse_.title: Card Terminal Operation Status Response

serviceWindow.description: Defines the operational time window for the terminal.

version.description: Version number of the terminal's configuration.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the terminal operation.
